backup.production_rule: Expand only: five nullable columns on public.transactions (hidden_at, hidden_by, archived_at, archived_by, archived_prev_status), one check constraint (archived_at implies status void; every existing row has archived_at null so it holds), one function public.admin_transactions_bulk_v1(), granted to authenticated only. No data change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: columns_exist_and_nullable
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 5 and bool_and(is_nullable = 'YES') from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'transactions' and column_name in ('hidden_at','hidden_by','archived_at','archived_by','archived_prev_status')

forward_verification.name: archived_is_void_constraint_present_and_validated
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(convalidated) from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass and conname = 'transactions_archived_is_void_check'

forward_verification.name: no_existing_row_is_hidden_or_archived
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from public.transactions where hidden_at is not null or archived_at is not null

forward_verification.name: function_exists_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = 'admin_transactions_bulk_v1'

forward_verification.name: grants_authenticated_only_anon_and_public_none
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.admin_transactions_bulk_v1(uuid,uuid[],text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.admin_transactions_bulk_v1(uuid,uuid[],text,text)','execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.admin_transactions_bulk_v1(uuid,uuid[],text,text)'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: void_and_confirmed_counts_unchanged_by_the_release
forward_verification.query: select count(*) filter (where status = 'void') >= 1 and count(*) filter (where status = 'void' and archived_at is not null) = 0 from public.transactions

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261005_transactions_hide_archive.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it puts any archived row back to the status it had, then drops the function, the constraint and the five columns. Take a backup first; dropping the columns loses who hid or archived what. Roll the admin dashboard back too.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_app
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE the admin dashboard build that selects hidden_at and archived_at is published: its list query reads both columns and the action bar calls admin_transactions_bulk_v1, so the Transactions page errors until they exist.

compatibility.rehearsal: PASSED 2026-10-05 (session 71) on cascade-supabase-20261005T105322Z: 1/1 migration, 6/6 forward checks, pgTAP transactions_hide_archive 36/36. Re-run on the final commit before apply.
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-05): transactions has no hidden or archived column; status check allows pending_review, confirmed, void; trigger trg_direct_booking_cascade cancels the guest booking when a direct_booking row becomes void, so the RPC refuses to archive a live direct booking payment. Old writers (Telegram bot, ingestion, admin_save_transaction_v1) never set the new columns; they are nullable with no default.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the admin dashboard build is published before this release is applied
